attBesluta.text: This was easy to put together and has stood up to a lot of pool side abuse over the summer. It has been outside since being put together and has held up well here in the Phoenix heat. It has also held up against multiple kids and their friends using it for pretty much everything except what it was designed for. At the end of the day it does work well for what it was designed for and even holds your drink.
Easy to put together nice chairs for around the pool
Well made. Take your time assembling and don’t over tighten the screws and you’ll be happy! wonderful addition to the pool without having to take out a loan for the chairs at the pool stores.
Well made, well packaged, easy to assemble. Really good to use.
Moderately easy to put together… all the tools needed were supplied. Pieces well organized and sorted. Really like the cup holder and adjustable back. They look great
